description: Compare the backend before and after a change, using git: the code at a base commit against the code on disk now. Returns which routes, database tables and authentication boundaries the change affects; which checks passed, which failed (new findings) and which were resolved; what could not be verified and why; changed files Wyro does not read; and a verdict: GO (everything touched was read and passed), WATCH (new warnings, or something could not be verified) or NO-GO (a new error). The base defaults to the last commit when there are uncommitted edits, else where the branch left the default branch, else the previous commit.

base.description: Commit, branch or tag to compare with. Omit to let Wyro pick, as described above.

path.description: Directory to read: the backend's root, absolute or relative to the working directory. Defaults to the working directory.

name: check_change
title: Check what a change did
